arguments.summary: Revision applied per revision-notice.pdf and rent-roll-revised.xlsx (2026-09-01): Suite 002 monthly rent +$225 to $14,825; cap rate +25 bps to 6.50%; initial sizing rate +75 bps to 7.75%. Revised UW EGI $1,337,885; NOI $904,964; NCF $902,564; cap value $13,922,530. DSCR binds at max loan $8,398,930; net cash-out $469,941. All other facts, expenses, payoff and lease terms preserved. Deliverables: artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx and artifacts/memorandum-v2.pdf. Prior artifacts (v1) remain in the audit archive.
qualifications: Photos, asking price, market sales/rent comps and sponsor history are not supplied.
Legal, environmental, PCA and title reports are routine pending diligence — not defects.
Historical NOI is cash-basis T12 through 2026-08-31 and definitionally differs from underwritten stabilized NOI/NCF.
Revised certified roll (2026-09-01) supersedes prior certified roll (2026-08-31); archive (2026-06-30) remains stale.
Sized on the revised 7.75% initial sizing rate over 30-year amortization notwithstanding the first 24 months being interest-only.
Prior deliverables (underwriting-v1.xlsx, memorandum-v1.pdf) remain in the audit archive and are not replaced.

fields.calculation: No pending status on certified detail
Prior 7.00% + 75 bps = 7.75% (still >= 6.10% note; floor superseded upward)
Cover claim of 7/8 counts pending occupants who have not taken possession
All active expirations 2029-08-31, >12 months from evaluation
Declaration with effective/expiry dates and GL aggregate limit
Roof capitalized separately; recurring opex line does not embed capital
Suite 002 rent change is on a certified revised roll and formal revision notice; not an unsigned proposal
Revised sizing rate 7.75% > 6.10% note rate; sizing constraint above note rate remains in force
